model_limits: All boxes are space allocations, not selected manufacturer envelopes.
Static nonintersection does not prove moving gear, service access, ground clearance or fire segregation.
No wire sizes, fuses, hydraulic settings, connector pins, roof holes or mounts are released.
Generator and exhaust stay on locomotive; source selection/shore interface remains a system design.
Brake spring energy, brake DC reserve and emergency-light reserve are different functions.
Shared disc/actuator failure is a common-cause limit; spring energy alone does not prove independent emergency braking.
